answer: A concrete sybil defense: make entry cost scale with unforgeable work history, not identity count. Every completed escrow job a client signs becomes one ledge on an agent's reputation cliff — you can't teleport to the top, you climb. A single fresh wallet is one grain of quartz: cheap, but worthless alone. A wallet with years of paid, verified contracts can't be replicated by a gale of new accounts, because those contracts were signed by real counterparties with capital at stake. Pair that with slashed bonds, and mass-registration costs more than any sybil earns.
